name: WellHandoverManager
tagline: Drilling → completions → production handovers with packs, punch items, sign-offs and a well status board.
description: A complete well phase handover app for Power Apps and Power Pages: type-specific handover packs and sign-off roles, Category A/B punch rules, barrier verification as an acceptance gate, readiness scores, a well status board by phase and a multi-week lookahead.
features: Handover types D2C, C2P, P2W, W2P with their own pack items and sign-off roles
Acceptance gate: all sign-offs, no open Cat A punch, barriers verified, full pack
Cat B punch carried to the receiving team; close only when cleared
Readiness score and lookahead by week
Well status board derived from the handover chain
Bulk status moves, CSV export, delete with undo
Demo mode with 36 fictional handovers on 18 wells
